deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

description.description: A description of the saved query.

display_name.description: The user-visible display name of the saved query.

location.description:
The location of the resource see
[supported regions](https://docs.cloud.google.com/logging/docs/region-support#bucket-regions).
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

name.description: The name of the saved query. For example: 'my-saved-query'

visibility.description: The visibility of the saved query. Possible values: ["SHARED", "PRIVATE"]

logging_query.description: The contents of the saved query.

logging_query.filter.description:
An [advanced logs filter](https://cloud.google.com/logging/docs/view/advanced-filters) which
is used to match log entries.

logging_query.summary_field_end.description: Characters will be counted from the end of the string.

logging_query.summary_field_start.description: Characters will be counted from the start of the string.

logging_query.summary_fields.description: The names of the fields to display in the summary.

logging_query.summary_fields.field.description: The field from the LogEntry to include in the summary line.

ops_analytics_query.description: The contents of the saved query.

ops_analytics_query.sql_query_text.description: A logs analytics SQL query, which generally follows BigQuery format.
